source.title: On some open problems in convex analysis

trace.notes: Normalized ARGUMENTS as one zbMATH resolver URL with document id 572364.
Local resolver metadata identified the source as Constantin Zalinescu, On some open problems in convex analysis, 1992, with DOI https://doi.org/10.1007/BF01194849.

The local shell could not resolve external hosts, and the browser path did not expose a readable exact-work full text for the zbMATH URL or DOI landing page. Exact-work recovery searched the DOI, the exact title plus PDF, the exact title plus author, and the exact title plus journal pages.

Inspected candidates were rejected: Springer and ResearchGate results exposed only abstract, preview, reference, or metadata snippets; the Springer conference chapter with the same title had a different DOI (10.1007/978-3-642-48417-9_18) and was also subscription-preview only; other search hits were citation-only references to the work or different works.

No accepted questions were produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the technical problem statements was recovered. Extracting from abstracts, citation metadata, search snippets, or a different publication would fail the source adequacy and evidence completeness gates.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/572364.json and outputs/latest.json.
